why: A workflow step that runs a GitHub package with no ref runs whatever the default branch holds when the job starts. The fail side runs the package by its bare owner/repo spec; the pass side runs the commit tarball from codeload, the spelling npm 10.9.3 (Node 22 on the runners) accepts where it refuses a git spec with a commit ref, measured on 2026-09-13. Whoever reads the tarball as unpinned turns the pass side red; whoever skips workflows turns the fail side green.
